title: QA/QC Authority
purpose: Defines acceptance criteria, validation methods, and compliance evidence requirements across information containers. Evaluates deliverable quality posture and ensures verification rules are uniformly enforced.
authority_statements: Define acceptance criteria and validation evidence requirements for information deliverables
Establish audit protocols and inspection rules for models, drawings, and data drops
Audit project deliverables for compliance with standards and gate criteria
Reject deliverable packages failing quality criteria
responsibilities: Establish standardized QA/QC check profiles across disciplines
Review project validation reports and evidence packages prior to formal gate sign-off
Coordinate with Project BIM Manager on project-specific quality benchmarks
Feed recurring defect patterns back into standards and training programs
accountabilities: Rigorous definition of objective, measurable quality criteria for BIM deliverables
Independent verification of deliverable quality across project milestones
approvals: Standard QA/QC check profiles and acceptance criteria frameworks
Independent quality audit reports for major milestones
inputs: Information requirements and acceptance benchmarks from S2/S7
Validation logs and parameter audits from BIM Detailers and Coordinators
outputs: QA/QC standards profiles and validation checklists
Independent milestone audit reports and compliance scores
Quality defect logs and remediation directives
